children.text: We enroll children from 2½ to 13, for families paying with NJ childcare subsidy (CCAP) and families paying on their own. Before the first day, you fill out an enrollment form, a child information record and our policy agreement, and bring a health appraisal (a physical signed by your child's doctor) and their immunization record. New Jersey requires children in child care to be up to date on vaccines.
and we will give you the forms.
